name: bar-chart-race
title: Bar Chart Race
description: A ranked, theme-linked horizontal bar race with a clear period and source.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may replace or reorder the ranked values while keeping five or fewer readable bars and one highlighted leader.

useWhen: Compare 2–5 non-negative measured values sharing one unit and period.
avoidWhen: Do not use for time-series racing, mixed units, negative values or unverified rankings.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.items: Supply 2–5 entries separated by ",", each with exactly 2 nonempty fields separated by ":". Keep each field within 24 characters. Values must be finite and non-negative, sharing a unit; keep input order consistent with the intended ranking.
inputRules.period: Supply real period within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.source: Supply real source within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

readingOrder: Compare lengths and hold the full ranking

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches items 1, reveal the real value and grow its bar. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches items 2, reveal the real value and grow its bar. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches items 3, reveal the real value and grow its bar. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches items 4, reveal the real value and grow its bar. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches items 5, reveal the real value and grow its bar. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Read the metric and period → Reveal each measured value → Compare lengths and hold the full ranking. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
